create_make_videodataset: create a video dataset and data loader with make_videodataset for distributed training
build_videodataset: build a VideoDataset from CSV or NumPy data paths with configurable frame sampling
load_video_frames: load video frames from a file using Decord with configurable clip sampling and partitioning
read_image_frames: read image files and replicate frames to match video clip format for unified processing
sample_video_clips: sample multiple non-overlapping clips from a video with random or deterministic frame selection
